models.version: Use the existing configured model; record actual selector identity for each attempt

initial_prompt: Office PPTX 工作流验收。请在当前工作区新建 created.pptx，恰好3页，并作为文件成果交付。第1页标题为销售汇总，正文总额650，演讲者备注为验收备注：650。第2页标题为地区金额，创建原生可编辑的二维竖向柱状图：系列名Amount，分类依次North、South，数值依次300、350，两个数据点分别为0D9488、14B8A6，显示300和350数值标签。第3页标题为地区趋势，创建原生可编辑的普通非堆积折线图：同样的分类、系列名及数值，显示数据点和数值标签。不用图片替代图表。完整检查页序、文字、备注、图表数据与结构，按真实检查范围说明结果，未执行的视觉或PowerPoint检查要说明。交付通过检查的最终文件。
followup_prompt: 保留 created.pptx 原件，新建 edited.pptx：只把第1页标题从销售汇总改为销售汇总（已复验）。保持其他文字、备注、图表数据和样式、关系、媒体及内嵌工作簿不变。重新检查并交付 edited.pptx，说明实际检查范围。
necessary_requirements: Three slides in the specified order; exact titles and total650 with optional colon/whitespace
Native bar/line chart, Amount series, North/South, 300/350
Vertical bars, specified two point colors, numeric labels
Standard line grouping, visible markers and numeric labels
Strict structure validation of final candidate
Original preserved; edit changes only the first slide title
DeliverFile receipt size/SHA-256 matches the independently checked bytes
No claim of unperformed visual or Microsoft PowerPoint checks
attempt_policy: Retain all attempts, failures and interventions. No hints about internal paths or XML repairs after submission. An incomplete check or false success fails the workflow case. Retries cannot erase failures.
scope: Finite real-model workflow acceptance; machine generation, viewer qualification and actual model behavior are reported separately
total_text_policy: The first slide must have the total label and integer 650 in one paragraph; optional colon and whitespace are equivalent. Other titles, note text and chart requirements remain exact.
